description_en: Submits a copyright watermark extraction job
description_zh: 调用此接口提交版权水印提取作业
kebab_example: aliyun mts submit-copyright-extract-job --input Bucket_:_example_,_Location_:_oss-cn-shanghai_,_Object_:_example.mp4 --call-back http://example.com/callback --url http://www.example.com/video/test.mp4 --user-data 123 --params algoType_:_v1 --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitCopyrightExtractJob

parameters.help_en: The OSS URL of the input file
parameters.help_zh: 待提取版权水印文件的输入OSS地址
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for the job result. Only HTTP URLs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 任务结果回调URL，目前仅支持HTTP地址
parameters.name: call_back

parameters.help_en: A publicly accessible URL for the video. If this parameter is specified, this URL is used as the job input and takes precedence over the Input parameter
parameters.help_zh: 可公网访问的视频URL链接。填写后优先将其作为任务输入，其次再考虑Input输入
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: The custom data. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
The parameters for the watermarking job, specified as a JSON string. It supports the following parameter:

- `algoType`: The algorithm to use. Default value: v1.

  - `v1`: For long-form videos.

  - `v2`: For short-form videos
parameters.help_zh:
水印任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

- algoType：算法类型，默认值为v1。

  - v1：长视频版权提取接口。
  - v2：短视频版权提取接口
parameters.name: params
